Name: Infested Monster Totems
Author: cakeymat
Description:
[b][size=5]Infested Monster Totems[/size][/b]

[b]Ever wished you could find those pesky Dust Sprites when you actually NEED them? Tired of wandering aimlessly through the mines hoping to stumble upon specific monsters? Well, look no further![/b]

Introducing Infested Monster Totems - your one-way ticket to monster-hunting paradise! This mod adds 12 unique totems that let you warp directly to areas infested with specific monsters. Whether you're hunting Slimes for that elusive Ring of Yoba, farming Dust Sprites for Coal, or just want to show those Cave Bugs who's boss, there's a totem for every occasion!

[b][size=4]Features:[/size][/b]

[*]12 unique monster-specific totems
[*]Earn totem recipes by proving your monster-slaying prowess
[*]Buy crafted totems from the Adventurer's Guild (once you've unlocked the recipes)
[*]Fully configurable monster kill requirements and shop prices
[*]Marlon sends you encouraging letters when you unlock new recipes (he's your biggest fan!)


[b][size=4]Available Totems:[/size][/b]

[*]Slime Totem
[*]Bug Totem
[*]Skeleton Totem
[*]Bat Totem
[*]Spirit Totem
[*]Duggy Totem
[*]Dust Sprite Totem
[*]Crab Totem
[*]Mummy Totem
[*]Dinosaur Totem
[*]Serpent Totem
[*]Magma Sprite Totem


Each totem requires specific monster parts to craft, along with some basic materials. The more dangerous the monster, the more valuable their totem!

[i]Note: Side effects may include: sudden wealth from monster loot, an overwhelming sense of satisfaction, and Marlon constantly praising your monster-hunting skills. The mod author takes no responsibility for any obsessive totem collecting behavior that may develop.[/i]

Compatible with SMAPI 4.0+ and Stardew Valley 1.6+

[i]"These totems are quite something, aren't they? Use them wisely!" - Marlon[/i]
